sermon.title: Make Room for Jesus 12/23/2018
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: In a Christmas-season message, the speaker teaches from Psalm 91 that those who dwell in the secret place of the Most High are protected and blessed, but we must make room for God. Like the inn with no room and the Shunammite woman who built an upper room, we choose whether there is space for Jesus.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He says the woman made a room “for a prophet Elijah”; in 2 Kings 4 it is Elisha. His words kept. The captions end about a minute before the video does.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And he said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Look, you have been concerned for us with all this care. What can I do for you? Do you want me to speak on your behalf to the king or to the commander of the army?’ ” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then he said, “About this time next year you shall embrace a son.” And she said, “No, my lord. Man of God, do not lie to your maidservant!” But the woman conceived, and bore a son when the appointed time had come, of which Elisha had told her.
